config.alias_caveat: Model aliases float: the provider may replace the model behind "opus"/"sonnet" at any time. A result is only comparable to another with the same runtime_version and a nearby measured_at. Re-measure before trusting an older number, and never carry a recall figure forward across a model change in either direction.
